reviews.name: Jeff Kinney
reviews.text: Croatia 2026 was amazing! An unforgettable trip filled with nonstop fun, incredible people, and Kaia, Eli, and Lizzie were amazing leaders who made the whole experience feel effortless. Croatia was the perfect backdrop for so much incredible fun, already counting down to the next SYB trip!

reviews.name: Timothy Dunn
reviews.text:
My first Surf Yoga Beer trip was Iceland in 2025, and since then I’ve been back again and again: Croatia, the Dolomites, Val Thorens, the Amalfi Coast, and the South of France. I think that says more than any review ever could.

Every trip has been completely different, but one thing has remained consistent: exceptional people, outstanding leadership, and experiences that exceed every expectation. Mantas, Bradford, Eli, Steph, and the entire SYB team have built something that’s incredibly difficult to replicate. They don’t just organize trips—they create an environment where strangers quickly become friends and unforgettable memories happen naturally.

The itineraries are always excellent, but they’re honestly the least important part of the experience. What makes Surf Yoga Beer special is the community. The people you meet, the friendships you build, and the moments that happen between the planned activities are what keep me coming back.

After six trips, I can confidently say this is one of the best decisions I’ve ever made for travel. If you’re on the fence, stop overthinking it. Book the trip. You’ll understand why so many people come back year after year.

reviews.name: Heather Wohaska
reviews.text:
UPDATE! I recently went to Nicaragua (with a much smaller crew than Croatia) so I have the luck of sharing perspectives from both. I loved Nica so much. The villas were truly magical 24/7. The workouts were amazing, shout out to Jenny for leading us day and night with different programs that left me feeling so accomplished. I loved that we had multiple days of surf lessons to practice or catch-up on the beach with new friends. Being in my 30s, I usually feel hesitant to join group trips like this, but I felt our dynamic was perfect with the diverse age range and mix of activities where every night didn't have to be a party if you wanted to catch the sunrise together the next day. You can also feel how integrated SYB is in this beach community and it makes you feel right at home. I felt relaxed yet fulfilled with health and fitness. 10/10 would recommend.

SYB Croatia 2024: I'm really happy I booked a solo trip with SYB to Croatia! I loved the daily workouts/yoga before heading off to local adventures like hiking, biking, and kayaking. Mantas and Steph fostered a culture of fun while pushing your limits for personal growth with a group of strangers that quickly become friends from all over the world. I would definitely recommend.

reviews.name: Sam Provence
reviews.text: I have struggled to find people to travel with which ultimately led me to booking my SYB Croatia trip. Everyone was super open-minded and friendly. There was a great balance of fitness/fun and Croatia itself was absolutely epic. The trip leaders did a great job being accommodating and integrating themselves with us. I’d highly recommend putting yourself out there and taking the leap to book a trip with them - you won’t regret it!

reviews.name: Steve Borodin
reviews.text:
I have done two trips now with SYB, Nicaragua NYE and Croatia.  My first one on NYE was intended to be a one time deal, until I saw the caliber of experience put together by the team.  Everything from the lodging, to the location, the food, the social scene, the cultural scene, and the unbelievable boat days put this travel company head and shoulders above the rest.

Every day is plotted out for you with the perfect balance of local area exploration, fitness, mindfulness, and partying.  Whether you come alone or with a friend, you’ll meet dozens of people from all walks of life.  Everyone brings something to the table to make that trip one of the most memorable experiences of your life.

From the cliffside yoga platform in Nicaragua to the legitimate PIRATE SHIP you’ll sail through the Adriatic Sea on the Croatia trip, you totally leave reality behind for a week when you’re with these people.  The variety and breadth of experiences you have available with the full portfolio of SYB locations is unparalleled.  The nightlife scene is pretty top tier as well.  SYB is the perfect way to explore a new location with a great group of people around you.

Mantas may have focused so much on his abs that he forgot how to properly shotgun a beer, but it doesn’t stop him from putting together a top tier trip, from top to bottom.  Book your next getaway with SYB, you won’t regret it!

reviews.name: Nicole Montalbano
reviews.text: Another 10/10 trip in Croatia for my third SYB trip. We had boat day on this pirate ship, went cliff jumping, swam into a cave, hiked, very well rounded trip. The group was also incredible and once again came home with some new very great friends.

reviews.name: Liyan Chen
reviews.text: Croatia 2025 was my first SYB trip, and it was an experience of a lifetime. The itinerary had a bit of everything: fitness, relaxation and fun. The leaders are always a vibe and they make sure that everyone is well taken care of!

reviews.name: Ilana Galed
reviews.text: SYB Croatia 2025 - Wow what a whirlwind of an adventure.  I went solo not knowing anyone and left with some incredible friendships and memories.  From the activities to the workouts to the parties, Group leaders Eli / Sarah Cat / Mantas / Steph / Courtney all made this trip INCREDIBLE. '10/10 reccomend for ANYONE you will not regret it!!! Everyday was more memorable than the last.  I cannot wait to go back - experience of a lifetime and now apart of the SYB fam :)

reviews.name: Lauren Turner
reviews.text: I truly can not say enough good things about SYB! Croatia was my first experience traveling with them but it certainly won’t be my last. The itinerary, the leaders, the people all exceeded my expectations. They made it easy by handling all of the logistics, fun with action packed days of adventure, and intentional with moments of connection and reflection. If you’re considering group travel, this is absolutely the company to choose!

reviews.name: Katie Waldner
reviews.text: SYB Croatia was a beautiful place to workout, adventure and party into the night with strangers that turned into friends. SYB is a one of a kind travel company that I would recommend to any of my friends and family who like to go go go!! All of the leaders were icons in every way and always kept our best interest at heart. Truly felt like adult summer camp in the best way.

reviews.name: Carri Bresnahan
reviews.text: WOW did SYB Croatia 2025 exceed my wildest dreams. I arrived knowing no one, and left with 74 new friends from across the country and the world. Our amazing trip leaders (Mantas, Steph, Sam, Eli, Darryl, Sarah, and Courtney) worked day and night to make this trip one that it will be impossible to forget. From unmatched fitness programming to daytime adventures to all night dance parties, every aspect of this trip was impeccably coordinated. The good news is that it’s never goodbye in the SYB family, it’s see you on the next trip!

reviews.name: Melanie Powell
reviews.text: If you’re interested in traveling “solo” but still want to embrace connection with others SYB is the company for you. I spent a lovely week in Croatia through SYB and it exceeded all my expectations. From the group leaders, to the planning, transparent communication, and everything in between, it was absolutely seamless. I met people that will forever hold a special place in my heart & exist in my memories simple because of SYB.

reviews.name: Isabelle Adler
reviews.text: Croatia was literally one of the best trips I have ever been on. The itineraries were jam packed with adventure and the leaders did a fantastic job ensuring that everyone felt comfortable and connected with one another. Absolutely insane trip. ❤️❤️❤️

reviews.name: Samantha Goldberg
reviews.text: I was unsure about going on a Surf Yoga Beer trip at first since I didn’t know anyone, but Croatia has always been on my bucket list so I decided to give it a try — and I’ve never been happier that I did! I did not expect to have this much fun or laugh this hard, nonstop, for an entire week. I met such an incredible group of people who I instantly felt comfortable with, and now we already have plans basically every other week at home. Honestly, it was the best combo of exploring, laughing, and just having a great time with awesome people. I will 100% be going on another SYB trip in the future — and if you’re on the fence, trust me, you should go on one too!

reviews.name: David S.
reviews.text: Just got back from an epic trip to Croatia with Surf Yoga Beer! I would highly recommend this company to anyone looking to take a group trip and meet people. This is a first-class operation from top to bottom. The leaders were awesome, and trip was extremely organized. This was one of the best trips I've ever been on. Everyone had an amazing time.

reviews.name: Carolyn Price
reviews.text:
I think solo travel can feel intimidating (especially as a woman), but SYB truly changes that! Through playful workouts, time in nature, and silly fun you're able to meet your people, explore new areas, recharge, build confidence, and leave with strong friendships.

I couldn't have been more excited to find SYB through a friend of a friend. After doing more research I decided to book the 2024 Croatia trip woohoo!! It looked like there was a good blend of time in nature, sightseeing, group workouts, and playtime.

In Croatia, I met 40+ other people who had a similar mindset and outlook on life. You quickly get to know everyone and naturally form close friendships through workouts, evening parties, day trips, and shared meals. Everyday was well planned, but you always had the option to do more or less (ie could skip the morning workout, could read by the pool instead of a bike ride on the island) as needed. Croatia highlights included lots of group workouts, kayaking, big parties on the boat, yoga/meditation, and explore the islands. I would highly recommend SYB to the "work hard, play hards" of the world!

reviews.name: tim reichmann
reviews.text:
I had the best summer experiencing two amazing Surf Yoga Beer (SYB) trips. First I went to their Croatia trip with 45 other people - what a party and what a beautiful place! Then I spent two weeks on a gulet boat sailing the Turkish coast between Marmaris and Bodrum - a much more leisurely and luxe lifestyle with 9 other adventurers.

Highlights:

Croatia: lots of group workouts, big parties, boat day on a massive pirate ship, kayaking, crystal clear waters, the hotel has a lovely sauna and spa facility, I made so many new friends on this trip! Definitely a big trip for partying but also lots of good workouts and meditation and moments of connection with others.

Turkey: You're on a really deluxe boat the whole time. There is a chef who makes you the best multi-course turkish meals for 3 meals a day, the cabins have nice showers and AC, I slept out under the stars on the day-beds most nights just because I could, we swam in the sea multiple times a day, went water-skiing/wake boarding/jet skiing, did a bunch of hikes to points with stunning views of the Turkish coastline, went clubbing in Marmaris and Bodrum with 9 of my new best friends.

Lowlights:
Going back to work/school after such a magical 3 weeks. Can't wait to go on my next SYB trip - hopefully one of the ones to Nicaragua so I can get my surf on!

About the company: I learned about SYB through Instagram ads and wondered how the actual experience would compare to the ads... I have to say it delivered exactly what was advertised. The boat in the ads was the boat we were on, the people in the ads and the quality of those photos is what they deliver with their professional photographers taking pictures of everyone all day every day. Lastly, Mantas (the founder) and Steph as well as all the other staff are incredible people (and fitness coaches) and the culture they've inspired SYB adventurers to be part of is really special.

reviews.name: Eric Mendelsohn
reviews.text:
I recently experienced an incredible group trip to Croatia with Surf Yoga Beer, and it exceeded all expectations. From the moment we arrived until our final goodbyes, everything was meticulously planned, making it one of the most memorable weeks of my life.

The itinerary was flawless, offering a perfect mix of activities: from hiking and kayaking to exploring Dubrovnik, morning workouts, and evening yoga sessions. The accommodations were comfortable and conveniently located right on the Adriatic Sea, providing breathtaking views.

What truly made this trip unforgettable was the connection with like-minded, adventurous travelers who were all there for the same reason: to embrace adventure and have fun. Even though most of us came solo, the camaraderie that formed among us turned strangers into friends, enhancing the entire experience.

If you’re seeking a well-organized, enriching travel adventure, I highly recommend Surf Yoga Beer. The leaders, Steph, Mantas, and Daryl, were outstanding, ensuring everyone had an incredible time. Whether you're traveling alone or with friends, they make sure your journey is unforgettable. Thank you, Surf Yoga Beer, for an amazing adventure. I can’t wait for the next one!

reviews.name: Ben DiMauro
reviews.text: Just got back from Croatia. What an epic experience! Mantas, Steph and team exceeded expectations. Great workouts to get you moving in the morning, activities during the day and fun parties / dinners to keep things going into the night. And who can forget MF Ship Day!! Best testimonial I can give - within 48 hours of returning home I booked another trip. Nicaragua here we come!!!

reviews.name: Paul Yanosy
reviews.text: I am wrapping my first trip with SYB in Croatia. This team and this trip are legend. I will absolutely do another. I've traveled the world - both solo and small groups. If you want fitness, adventure, new friends, new places, hammering a workout one minute and then getting deep the next - this is your tribe. Picture your favorite Peloton or Soul Cycle or yoga instructor who also loves international travel and trip planning and an occasional beer. If that's your jam - I'll see you on a trip soon.

reviews.name: Patrick Jennings
reviews.text:
I just finished my first SYB trip to Croatia.

With yoga, early morning workouts, sunset pirate ship parties, ocean kayaking, historical exploration, cliff jumping and simply just getting to connect with cool people this trip has something for everyone.

From start to finish, Mantas and his elite team of leaders did a beautiful job making sure everyone had a great time and got to experience something unique.

If you’re hesitant about signing up, just do it. You wont regret it!

reviews.name: Mahmood Reza
reviews.text:
Spent a week with SYB in Croatia and had a blast. Loved the workouts, camaraderie and meeting lots of like minded people. Really loved Steph & Mantis’ energy and how they balance each other. The Deep convos were my favorite. As with most group trips (or anything in life) it’s what you make of it. If you want a trip to spend your time on a bender you could do that; or if you wanted to just focus on early mornings, workouts and sightseeing you could do that too. The group was pretty accommodating.

Generally, I’d very much consider going on another trip with less people. It’s really hard to get to know 40+ people in a week; but regardless still a worthwhile adventure.

My major gripe was why bother flying in a DJ if the person is not going to do their job and focus more on fraternizing with the clientele? (That’s the kindest way I can put it). Numerous times we were left at the events with zero DJ at the booth and someone else focusing on the playlist. Seems like a waste of time and frankly entirely unprofessional / low integrity behavior. My advice: find someone who can be a professional and whose focus and passion is DJing. Not this charlatan we had. I won’t go into further details publicly.

Besides that as I said, you can make the trip whatever your heart desires. Want to relive spring break in college? Feel free. There’s a few folks who did that. Want to focus more on being an adult? Room for that too. All were welcome. The senior staff (Mantis, Steph) plus Chuks, Sam & Darryl did a great job shepherding us around Croatia. Will likely try a smaller group to see how the dynamics work out (I’ve been on many group tours in the past with other operators) and genuinely enjoyed this trip. With a few tweaks I think this trip could be spectacular.

reviews.name: Dan Brown
reviews.text: Recently returned from the Croatia trip, and it was a life changing experience.  I left with a newfound confidence, purpose, and 50+ new friends who will truly be a part of my life forever.  The leadership and staff are excellent and know exactly how to calibrate the experience to push you out of your comfort zone just enough, while always making it an epically fun experience.  I've already booked my next trip!

reviews.name: Emma Stallwood
reviews.text:
My recent Croatian adventure with SurfYogaBeer was an epic trip of kayaking, biking, hiking, and running in breathtaking landscapes. What truly made this journey remarkable were the exceptional leaders. The leaders on this trip were phenomenal. They demonstrated a passion for adventure, empathy by making everyone feel included and supported, adaptability by effortlessly navigating changing conditions and prioritizing our safety and enjoyment, and clear communication to steer this journey flawlessly.

In summary, Surf Yoga Beer's Croatia adventure, led by these extraordinary individuals, was a life-changing experience. If you seek adventure, growth, and unforgettable memories, look no further. They set the bar high.

reviews.name: Suad Bektic
reviews.text:
I just got back from the Croatia trip and can honestly say that it was one of the best weeks of my life. I chose to travel with SYB in the first place because I felt that I had a very good idea of what I was going to be getting out of the experience by looking at their vast social media posts. And, it was absolutely as advertised. The views and adventures are as advertised, and absolutely marvelous. The guests (men and women - close to even split) were all attractive both inside and out. And all the leaders are as top notch as they come.

However, to say that the trip met my expectations would be an extreme understatement. It was SO MUCH more than that!! The bond and love that our group has developed in just 8 days is certainly nothing I have ever been a part of before. So much so that many of us have already booked future trips and made other arrangements to meet.

Lastly, you will absolutely grow as an individual as well. The energy and encouragement is nothing short of contagious. You’ll do things you never thought you could and you will learn to appreciate yourself in ways you deserve.

Life changing and the most fun you can possibly have in a week!

reviews.name: Sunny Sangha
reviews.text:
Where do I start?  I've known about SYB for years now and have followed their journey online but never committed to a trip until this year.  I can't believe it took me so long to pull the trigger but I'm so grateful I did.  This past trip to Croatia was exactly what I needed.  It challenged me physically and mentally, it introduced me to so many wonderful new people, and most importantly it re-inspired me to just be me!  I can't say enough about the welcoming and inclusive environment that the leaders fostered right from the first hello.  Keep it up SYB fam, can't wait to see you again.

If you're still thinking about joining a trip don't make the same mistake I did by waiting, book one now!

reviews.name: Oumniya Bouhdoud
reviews.text:
SYB Croatia was by far one the best trips I have done in my lifetime. It was a week where we were all fully present with each other, experiencing life at 1000%! I got it all: met new lifetime friends from all over the world which I stayed very close to after the trip, witnessed the most wonderful landscapes, had amazing fitness, kayak / cycling and yoga classes everyday, challenged myself by jumping out of a cliff and had a lot of fun along the way      The leaders are 5 stars and their energy is so communicative you will find yourself quickly vibrating at a whole different level. And of course…. SHIP day was out of this world, still day dreaming about it!
At the end of the trip, I felt so grateful for all the genuine love and friendship that this adventure have created and the last yoga class where we all opened up to each other was very emotional to say the least.
I would highly recommend this trip to anyone looking for a super energising experience in a dreamy environment to create long-lasting positive habits and genuine friendships.

reviews.name: Enoch Cheng
reviews.text:
SurfYogaBeer has been on my list for a few years now after meeting Mantas a few years back. This year, the stars finally aligned for SYB Croatia.

Although I've traveled a lot, I've never done a trip with mostly complete strangers. However, after coming back I can unequivocally say it was one of the best experiences I've had abroad. SYB takes care of all of the worst part of going on a trip...the itinerary and logistics. Our activities (kayaking, boat day, hikes, workouts, happy hours) and lodging were all taken care of to a tee.

On the more personal front, we all came as strangers but left as friends some of whom I still talk to daily. A group of 40+ people spanning different backgrounds can get cliquey quickly but Mantas/Steph do a great job of picking the right personalities for the final roster but more importantly going out of their way to get to know each and every person on the trip. I experienced immense physical, spiritual, and mental breakthrough on the trip. There are also a few cool surprises which you'll have to go on a trip to find out.

reviews.name: Ab Gupta
reviews.text:
Grateful that I randomly discovered SYB via a Google search and decided to hop on one of their trips.

A rare travel company that combines fitness, socialising, fun and adventure all into one.

The Croatia 2022 trip was amazing, right from the island of choice (Lopud) to how every minute of every day was scheduled and organised.

Hats off to Mantas, Steph and all the leaders. Hope to do more with SYB in the coming months/years.

Highly recommend.

  ‍♀️   ‍♂️

reviews.name: Madeleine Dunn
reviews.text:
Just spent 10 minutes learning how to write a google review (my first one) because I feel so strongly about how fantastic this trip was! I went to Croatia this past summer 2022 with a group of ~40 other people. I was expecting good vibes, beautiful atmosphere, and some tough workouts. All of this was delivered, and more! I’ve been on 1-2 week vacations in Europe since graduating from college seeking to “relax” and “recharge,” but only on this trip in seeking genuine connections with others and embracing a “don’t think, just do mentality” was I really able to disconnect from my fist time since college.

We’ve already had one reunion with the group, and it was crazy how strangers became friends became family. Steph and Mantis, who organize the trips, are truly fantastic and they select THE BEST leaders and crew. Truly felt like coming home sending everyone at the reunion <3.

reviews.name: Julia Winn
reviews.text: SYB is an amazing company. I've been on 2 of their trips (Croatia and Nicaragua) and had such an epic time on both. I just got back from Croatia and had the time of my life working out, doing relaxing yoga classes, boat days, hiking, kayaking, cliff jumping, cave exploring and more. The perfect trip for those looking to meet likeminded, active people and have fun at the same time. I made new friends and am excited to go on more trips in the future!

reviews.name: Jamielisa
reviews.text: An adventure of a life time, Croatia was like no other trip, each time I come to SYB its even more life changing then before, the trainers and workouts are the very best, Yoga everyday followed by a workout and some good drinking never goes a miss, it proves balance is the way forward and meeting like minded people in beautiful locations, Thankyou for creating such a wonderful brand!!

reviews.name: Jessica Chan
reviews.text: I've joined two of these trips - Croatia '21 and Kenya '22. Both were fantastic! Each trip has a consistent theme of being active and adventurous, yet is inclusive to the point where if you don't want to participate in some activities or workouts, there's no pressure to do so. Mantas, Steph, and the other leaders are absolutely lovely and have made what can be an initimidating week-long trip with a group of strangers very welcoming and comfortable. I have met some incredible people on these trips who I am now able to call friends and this is why I keep coming back!
